skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the concepts and functions of modern journalism and public relations, and apply them effectively in organizational communication strategies.
Analyze and solve problems related to public relations and journalism, identifying opportunities and challenges in media contexts.
Differentiate between various forms of modern journalism and utilize them as effective tools in public relations campaigns.
Create and evaluate press releases and media content that align with public relations objectives and media trends.
Deliver presentations and speeches on public relations and journalism topics effectively.
Collaborate with peers to develop and present public relations strategies and media content.
Conduct research and analyze data to inform public relations and journalism practices.
Utilize digital tools and platforms for creating and distributing media content.
Develop strategic plans for public relations campaigns using various forms of modern journalism.
Organize and manage events for public relations purposes.
Handle crises and manage public relations during critical situations.
Understand and apply principles of public relations in various media contexts.
Analyze media trends and their impact on public relations strategies.
Produce media content for public relations purposes.
Engage with media audiences effectively to achieve public relations goals.
Demonstrate professional behavior and ethics in public relations and journalism.
